ms.report:
Dear Catalyst Review Team,
with this milestone, we are submitting:
・A practical "how-to" guide for each template in the Cardano Contract Suite (publicly available at: Cardano Contract Suite page : https://catalyst.sparring.io/ ); and
・An explanatory document that goes deeper into the most negotiated and dispute-prone provisions (publicly available at: Extended Commentary: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1I-yHHcS9tardLG0-2UhbewlLnns6wSFSA9sLDjxjBuI/edit?usp=drive_link ).

The purpose of Milestone 2 is to turn the templates submitted in Milestone 1 from static legal documents into tools that the Cardano community can use correctly, especially if they don't have access to legal support.
Response to Previous Feedback
We understand the previous feedback regarding similarities to publicly available B2B contract templates. Our templates are intentionally built on market-leading terms to ensure that parties recognize the terms, negotiations are faster, and the documents are enforceable; hence, the documents resemble any high-quality templates.
Our added value for the Cardano community is not in inventing novel legal wording, but in:
・Adapting standard commercial contracts to blockchain-specific realities
・Making meaningful improvements based on our years of commercial negotiation experience in the technology space
・Explaining how the documents should be used and negotiated in Cardano projects

That is what Milestone 2 delivers.
The highlighted sections in each template are used intentionally as a user-friendly feature for non-lawyers. The goal is to make it immediately obvious where a user must fill in information or choose from optional alternatives based on the project structure and risk posture. In the how-to guides submitted in this milestone, each of those highlighted areas is now accompanied by clear instructions explaining what the decision means, when to choose each option, what is typically used in practice, and how the choice affects risks and negotiation.
